_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% coil-break rate and analyst's 0-for-18 directional record in similar windows make HOLD the statistically honest call — the August bottom analog tells us what may come next but does not move the current phase up the ladder without the ETF flow breaker confirming.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics and missing breakers; narrative implies directional upside via mean reversion with 0.78 confidence; judge sides with analyst's HOLD per trust weight and base-rate evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike above 30 AND btc_momentum_30d sustains above 55 AND funding stays below 60
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 75 AND DXY strengthens above 65 AND btc_momentum_30d rolls below 40
